_comment: Player params fitted from s7 clips with a key display (python -m measure.skatefit fit; CLAUDE.md 'Session s7'): wkeymovement, diagonalkeypresses, whilemovingturning (skating), dashatrest, dashwhilerunning (dash). Replaces the s6 video-only estimates (no input log): player_max_speed 11.84, player_accel 15.85, player_ice_drag 26.02. Meters at the PLACEHOLDER scale. dash_duration and dash_cooldown are not listed: the fit drives dash_duration to 0 (the sim's raised-cap window does not match a speed boost, and it also defines dash shots), and no clip has two dashes within a second, so the cooldown is not identifiable. Only names listed here change; params.json is untouched.

player_accel.note: skating acceleration with a move key held (constant ramp to the cap) = 279.1 px/s^2. Held-out by clip (fit on the other two of wkeymovement, diagonalkeypresses, whilemovingturning): 14.554-18.015; calib fitter (Nelder-Mead, time objective) on the runs of all three skating clips, inputs read from the key display (CLAUDE.md 'Session s7'). PLACEHOLDER scale (meters from the painted line spacing, 16.951 px per placeholder m); multiply lengths/speeds/accelerations by the real/placeholder factor (measure/results/scale.json) when the scale is applied. Standing-start ramp fits (key->motion lag model) give 14.4-22.1 m/s^2.

player_max_speed.note: speed cap = 180.0 px/s. Model-free plateau with a key held: 10.755 m/s (sd 0.035, n = 15 runs), dead flat (a hard cap); diagonal input (W+D, W+A) has the same top speed (normalized). Held-out by clip (fit on the other two of wkeymovement, diagonalkeypresses, whilemovingturning): 10.533-10.747; calib fitter (Nelder-Mead, time objective) on the runs of all three skating clips, inputs read from the key display (CLAUDE.md 'Session s7'). PLACEHOLDER scale (meters from the painted line spacing, 16.951 px per placeholder m); multiply lengths/speeds/accelerations by the real/placeholder factor (measure/results/scale.json) when the scale is applied.

player_ice_drag.note: coasting deceleration with no key held = 101.2 px/s^2 (the sim's model is a constant deceleration). The measured coast is closer to speed-proportional decay (rate 0.52-1.34 1/s, median ~0.85; fits better than a constant in all 11 coasts), so this constant is a compromise; the s6 value (26 m/s^2, stops of 0.07-0.25 s) cannot be coasting, which takes ~3 s here: probably active braking. Held-out by clip (fit on the other two of wkeymovement, diagonalkeypresses, whilemovingturning): 5.928-6.044; calib fitter (Nelder-Mead, time objective) on the runs of all three skating clips, inputs read from the key display (CLAUDE.md 'Session s7'). PLACEHOLDER scale (meters from the painted line spacing, 16.951 px per placeholder m); multiply lengths/speeds/accelerations by the real/placeholder factor (measure/results/scale.json) when the scale is applied.

dash_speed.note: COMPROMISE for the sim's additive dash impulse = 156.7 px/s, fitted on dashatrest + dashwhilerunning with stage A fixed. The data is a SPEED BOOST to a fixed speed, not an impulse: a dash (Shift with a move key) from rest peaks at 11.0-12.5 m/s within 0.12-0.22 s (10-90% rise 0.07-0.15 s), at top speed it only adds 0.45-3.33 m/s (peak 12.2-13.3). Held-out fails both ways (fit on the other clip: 6.41 / 9.82). Shift with no move key does nothing in the clips (the sim dashes along `facing`).
